newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end mixed, power shares rise.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end mixed, power shares rise.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed mixed in light trade with electricity shares among the leading gainers, while decliners included firms with investments in Argentina, traders said.
The bolsa is seen edging sideways at the opening with the lack of news continuing to deprive the market of momentum, they said.
The selective IPSA index closed down 0.02 percent at 98.52 points. The general IGPA index gained 0.14 percent to 5,422.73 points amid volume of 11.4 billion pesos.
The slack turnover reflected a lack of interest from institutional investors, with most trading from brokers reshuffling their own portfolios, said dealers.
The market's apathy was increased by comments from Central Bank president Carlos Massad reiterating his view that the bank will not cut interest rates until the first quarter of next year, they said.
"We are permanently examining the (economic) figures and there has not been until now any reason to change this policy," said Massad after meeting President Eduardo Frei.
Electricity stocks, which account for close to 40 percent of the weighting in the IPSA index, gained in a technical reaction to their fall on Monday, they said.
Endesa gained 0.78 percent to 257 pesos, while Enersis firmed 0.29 percent to 258-1/4 pesos.
Losers included companies with investments in Argentina on concerns about the Argentine economic situation following last week's general strike, said traders.
Bottler Andina lost 1.7 percent at 2,310 pesos with drug-maker LabChile down 0.92 percent at 322 pesos and forestry firm Masisa off 0.51 percent at 195 pesos.
